'''Torsteen''' was a male [[Svivreni]] crimelord who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Torsteen owned a scavenger droid, [[Bruthus]], and wanted to use it for salvage and recycling of space debris in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] for profit. During the operation, Bruthus kept the best waste and sold it himself, without Torsteen knowing it. As a result, Torsteen only obtained marginal profit.
